decisions.rationale: Consensus: 'reducing the growth' supports inhibition; the agreed species endpoint is inherited, not independently full-text verified.
'Significantly reduced' supports inhibition despite the weaker comparative effect; the comparator adds no independent arm, and the agreed species endpoint is inherited without full-text verification.

'Significantly reduced the growth' directly asserts one arm; the similarity reference does not independently restate the comparator outcome, and the agreed species endpoint is inherited without full-text verification.

'No significant difference' assigns measured nulls to three arms without a null direction; named biological agents favor ActiveIngredient over an unasserted formulation, and agreed endpoint expansions are inherited without full-text verification. Retain each quoted variant qualifier so normalized endpoints remain distinct.
The PBO-only plants “did not differ,” while the increased herbicidal effect explicitly qualifies PBO as applied “two hours before” both named inhibitor groups.
decisions.change_rationale: 'Did not differ' supplies the standalone null, while 'increased the herbicidal effect' supports two enhancement arms; treatment context is not a molecular variant, and enhancement does not establish formally quantified synergy.

decisions.rationale: The sentence attributes the decrease to “increasing density of the R and S blackgrass populations,” but names no chemical product or active ingredient required by the protocol’s scope.
The quote says “several accessions” but does not identify them as Poa annua, so neither reviewer’s named weed endpoint is grounded in the supplied sentence.
Consensus: 'no resistant isolate was observed' denotes three measured absence claims, not demonstrated control or refutation; the agreed species endpoint is inherited without full-text verification.
“Two phenotypes” identifies distinct resistance variants, while “B. cinerea populations” supplies their population context and “all 3 years” their study context.
The sentence names products and 'oviposition' but no pest endpoint.
'Ineffective in the field' does not name the pest being controlled.
'Did not significantly affect mortality' does not identify whose mortality was measured.
'Mortality was higher' does not identify the affected pest.
'The R population' is not identified as blackgrass or another weed in this sentence.
'Fresh weight reduction' does not identify the affected weed.
